data.description:
This version will only work for SPT ~4.1.0+

New Features

  • Updated to 4.1

Bugs Squashed

  • Resolved Scav key configs not weighting correctly
  • Resolved Scav Key configuration allowing multiple toggle types
  • Resolved Preset builder not using the new theme properly

This version will only work for SPT ~4.1.0+

Changes

  • Recursive detection will now only log a problematic item once instead of every instance of seeing it.
  • Fixed load order for vanilla caching
  • Bumped vanilla cache manifest version to force a re-cache

This version will only work for SPT ~4.1.x

New Features

  • WebConfig toggle for Pmcs to use level overrides for Ground Zero
  • WebConfig switch to use Weighted Tier Selection vs Level Delta (weighted system is enabled by default now)
  • WebConfig toggles/sliders for Custom Weighted Level Deltas
  • WebConfig page for showing bot generation logs and details
  • Bots have 33% chance to have loose ammo in Rig/Pockets
  • Blacklisting got a much needed refresh
  • Blacklisting can now bulk import comma delimited Item IDs and copy to other tiers
  • Preset Builder got a much needed refresh
  • Preset Builder can now change pages/tiers without requiring saves before navigation
  • Preset Builder can now copy information between tiers and bots

Changes

  • Added SIC Authorization attribute to WebConfig pages (not home page)
  • Added 25% chance for a prestige Pmc to get a non-prestige dogtag
  • Added Double Dogtag from WTT Content Backport to possible Pmc dogtags
  • Adjusted Pmc medical loot logic, should be much better with bots having actual medkits now
  • Adjusted loot cache handling
  • Adjusted Normalize Bot Health Exclusion list, probably works for custom bots now, I dunno I dont use them
  • Adjusted the Home page
  • Adjusted level calculation to average level of all players starting raid
  • Removed Disable Animations / Authorization code from WebConfig
  • Removed In Raid check

Bugs Squashed

  • Resolved Custom Tier Deltas not being removed when disabling them without restarting the server
  • Resolved Highest Prestige Level handling never resetting when not restarting the server
  • Resolved outdated Forge URL for update download link
  • Resolved various default values not being correct in WebConfig
  • Probably resolved instances of loot being empty on bots that should have loot, idk
  • Probably resolved Pmcs questing requiring a sniper generating an AXMC with !!invalid!! parts (I can’t fix conversions that mods do, they shouldn’t do that)

This version will only work for SPT ~4.1.x

Changes

  • Moved Loose Ammo chances and limits to the WebConfig for people who run massive ammo stack sizes
  • Added entry limits on new bot generation json since they no longer delete on server start

Bugs Squashed

  • Resolved mod clothing import not functioning properly
